finding.issue: The parser keeps `final_reports` from an earlier closed short-test-summary section when a later, final section starts but is truncated before its footer. A concrete bounded input consisting of a complete earlier spoof section (`FAILED tests/test_spoof.py::test_false`) followed by a final unclosed section (`FAILED tests/test_actual.py::test_real`) returns the earlier spoof identity instead of withholding it as untrustworthy. The candidate's truncated-summary regression tests only an unclosed section with no previously completed section. This contradicts AC4's required fail-closed spoofed/truncated-source behavior and its prohibition on silently misrepresenting source-known failures. Independently, `_parse_pytest_summary_reports` silently applies `_MAX_SUMMARY_SCAN_CHARS = 16 * 1024 * 1024` and returns the same empty list as absent/unsupported/malformed summaries when the scan budget is exhausted before the final section; the public safe_detail then labels it generic `UNAVAILABLE`, without the TASK-hard-required explicit exhausted-input status. Runtime evidence RUN-393-005-V001 proves the authored focused command exited 0 but does not semantically close these untested cases.
